In Year 1 (2023-10-01 to 2024-09-30), Oak Bay reported 16 net new units against a Year 1 target of 56: 29% of target.

Net new units = completions (occupancy permits) minus demolitions. Year 1 source: Secondary (news tracker), not independently verified.

Data notes

  • Census indicators are from 2021, the latest available; 2020 incomes included temporary pandemic benefits, which likely lowered measured need.
  • Values are for the municipality (census subdivision), not the wider metropolitan area, so they will differ from published CMA figures.

Sources: Statistics Canada, Census of Population 2016 and 2021, Table 98-10-0259-01.
